items.instrument: differential thermal analyzer 701L, Bähr Thermoanalyse GmbH, Hüllhorst, Germany
items.quote: The heating rate between 900 and 1500 8C was 5 8C/min. The temperature was measured with Pt-Pt/Rh thermocouples calibrated at the melting temperatures [1990Tho, 1991Din] of Al (660.3 8C), Ag (961.8 8C), Au (1064.2 8C), Si (1413.9 8C), and Ni (1455.2 8C). The accuracy of the temperature measurement was estimated to be 62 8C.

The starting materials used for the present investigation were powders of 99. 9% purity Si and 99.95% purity Cr (both from Johnson Matthey GmbH, Alpha Products, Karlsruhe, Germany). Appropriate powder mixtures were cold pressed, arc melted, sealed in evacuated quartz tubes (4 ? 1024 bar), annealed at 1000 8C for 13 days, and water quenched.
